text_block_list.text:
One day, I head over to the training
track...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... Phew... How was my time?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Perfection! And talk about form! Hey,
you! Wasn't
she amazing?!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
I'm guessin' that hot spring trip really
paid off.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we went to a hot spring the other
day, just
the two of us...
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: Mmm... That water felt sooo good...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But how come you invited me to the hot
spring all
of a sudden?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
You've been working yourself to the
bone lately,
so I figured washing your
fatigue away would do
you some good.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
It's nice to get away from the daily grind
every
once in a while, y'know?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: Palmer... Ehehe, thanks!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I booked us in for a beauty treatment
after this
too! ♪
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
B-beauty treatment?! Uh, that's not
really my
thing!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, just give it a try! It's not every
day that
you can get the full spa
experience!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Sure, it might be important to focus, but
you
need to escape sometimes too, you
know.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I wasn't expecting a beauty
treatment,
but I think my muscles are
looking way shinier
now.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, that manga you
were reading
the other day had a scene
where that couple ran
away to a hot
spring too, right?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was so swoon-worthy! The way
they held
hands as they walked along
the mountain path...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
...Wait. How do you know about my
favorite
manga?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Well, 'cause I like that comic too! ♪ A
romantic
getaway sounds so dreamy.
Like lovers on the
run...
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
L-l-lovers?! What are you talking about,
Palmer?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't be like that! Lemme
explain.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Y'know how characters in manga always
tell each
other how they feel when they
run off to
somewhere unfamiliar?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
That means their runaway romance is
what saves
the day!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's true that unfamiliar experiences help
you grow.

text_block_list.text:
That means their runaway romance is
what saves
the day!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's true that unfamiliar experiences help
you grow.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you escaped your grueling
training routine
by running off to the hot
spring, and that helped
you give your
muscles some TLC, yeah?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Your muscles are always taking good
care of you,
right? And this trip helped
you express your love
for 'em, didn't it?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: Yeah... You're right! I haven't been showing my muscles enough love and care lately!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I've been in such a rush to workout that I've been pushing them too hard... I guess I never thought about how they felt.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Palmer! You've really
opened my eyes
to something super
important!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I mean, training is kinda like escaping
from
everyday life anyway, so...
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! So the hot spring and
beauty
treatment were a form of training
to help
strengthen my mind!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Palmer! I'm gonna go hit the
showers and
ice up my muscles like a
monk standing under a
waterfall!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! Glad to help. And don't forget
to give
your muscles more runaway
romance! ♪
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Nice! I'd expect nothing less from a
muscle
maniac like you. A waterfall
escape... Now that
sounds refreshing. ♪
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
